findings.title: Required collection efforts were not performed for outstanding grants receivable.
findings.description: Grant amounts owed to UMCES were not always pursued in accordance with State regulations. Review of 10 delinquent grant accounts totaling approximately $280,000 disclosed that UMCES did not timely pursue collection for 8 accounts totaling approximately $253,600.
findings.recommendation: We recommend that UMCES issue demands for payment at the intervals required by State regulations.

extraction.agency_response_summary: UMCES is transitioning to a new billing and receivables system expected by late summer 2015 and has prioritized collection efforts, resulting in the collection of 85% of delinquent accounts.
